title: Content Briefs Generator
short: Turn your Semantic Keyword Universe sheet into up to 20 content briefs at a time, combining the sheet's keyword, entity and SERP data with suggestions from OpenAI.
needs: Your Semantic Keyword Universe Google Sheet shared as 'Anyone with the link can view', a Google Cloud API key with the Google Sheets API enabled, and your OpenAI API key
cost: Free to use; OpenAI bills your key per request. Each brief makes 7 requests: roughly 6 US cents a brief with GPT-5.6 Terra, under 1 cent with GPT-6 Luna. Reading the sheet costs nothing.
inputs: The URL of your keyword universe sheet, up to three of its topics, and how many briefs you want (1 to 20)
outputs: A ZIP of briefs as Markdown-formatted .txt files, one per keyword, which you can also preview and download one at a time
how: Share your keyword universe sheet so anyone with the link can view it. The tool reads the template's tabs by name, so keep them as they are.
Paste the sheet URL and your Google API key, then press Load topics.
Pick up to three topics and set how many briefs you want.
Add your OpenAI key, choose a model and press Generate.
Download the ZIP, and check every AI section before a writer works from it.
note: The AI sections are suggestions, not research: competitor gaps and internal-link targets are written from the keyword alone, so check them against the live results and your own site.
